beats.say: A painter comes to sketch the Mona Lisa, and finds an empty wall.
beats.label: AN EMPTY WALL

beats.say: The painting has been gone for more than a day.
Police question hundreds of people, even Pablo Picasso.
beats.label: PICASSO

beats.say: But the thief is a Louvre worker named Vincenzo Peruggia.
beats.label: THE THIEF

beats.say: He walks out with it, hidden under his work smock.
beats.head: POLICE REPORT

beats.say: For more than two years, the Mona Lisa sits in his room in Paris.
In 1913, he takes it to an art dealer in Florence.
Before the theft, it was not the world's most famous painting.
